title: Explicit pullback data and their four compatibility laws
statement: Construct a record of the actual two pullback functors, their two exact factor isomorphisms, the unary scalar comparison, preservation proofs, and the two tensor comparison transformations. Define its fixed, intrinsic, factors, and chain laws by the four equations of the proved representative cube. The tensorSquare theorem supplies those fields and laws to finiteScalarRepresentativeTensorCube. All data are explicit inputs; no map is selected.
